about: A cross-platform command-line tool for renaming many files and folders quickly and safely.

prs.title: Removing text from file names no longer crashes
prs.broken: On the development branch, renaming with an empty replacement, the usual way to delete part of a name, crashed with a nil pointer error.
prs.changed: The step that skipped setup for an empty replacement is gone, so the rename runs normally.
prs.matters: Removing a word such as -draft from many file names works again.
